nodes.label: research-pipeline-governed Scope
nodes.rationale: A composed scope (17 execute, 15 folded or skipped) for reproducible research pipeline work on a frozen data contract. Comprehensive depth is kept despite the lean grid because a governance board reads the surviving artifacts and a gate verdict turns on evidence quality, not stage count. Ships keywords: [] so it is resolvable only by explicit --scope and never participates in inference. Notable choices: reverse-engineering skips because CodeKB is the structural evidence source; the NFR pair stays unfolded because reproducibility, determinism and evaluation correctness interact and are reviewed as evidence; performance-validation is the deliverable rather than an afterthought; user-stories and mockups skip for lack of personas and UI; skeleton off because the frozen data contract leaves nothing to bootstrap.

nodes.label: TEC Governance Overlay
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT encoded in the scope file: the overlay is a project-level rule that gates human approval of each stage independently of AI-DLC's own completion signal. Comprehensive depth exists in the scope precisely so each stage's artifacts are reviewable at that external board.
